due.title: Check the root cards and prove they are alive
due.detail: Every six months both root cards are read against the layout and each passes the proof of life, a short test that the card still works for its holder. The last check was 2026-06-02.

due.title: Renew acme-ca for acme-gateway
due.detail: The certificate of the intermediate ends on 2027-01-02. After that the requester acme-gateway can no longer issue certificates.

due.title: Renew the release subkey acme-release
due.detail: The binding of the release subkey ends on 2027-02-27. After that releases cannot be signed.
